Getaways people love

Six easy trips — two beach, one mountain, and three city breaks — all reachable from the Southeast by a short flight or a drive. Pick one to start your plan.

Florida Panhandle

Destin, Florida

Emerald-green water, sugar-white sand, dolphin cruises, and deep-sea fishing out of Destin Harbor. Big condo towers and beach houses make it easy for groups.

Getting there: fly into VPS or PNS, or drive the Gulf Coast

Gulf Shores, Alabama

Gatlinburg, Tennessee

Gateway to Great Smoky Mountains National Park — the most visited national park in the U.S. Cabins with hot tubs, the Parkway strip, and Pigeon Forge attractions nearby.

Flight fares & hotel prices — checked live

Fares and room rates change by the hour, so this site doesn't guess them. Tell it your route and dates, and it hands you ready-made checks on the sites that show today's real numbers.

✈️ Fare finder

Enter a route and get one-tap fare checks, plus the tips that actually move the price.

Your fare checks

Open each one, compare the total price (fare + taxes + bag fees), then book with the airline or site you trust:

Google Flights ↗ Expedia ↗ Skyscanner ↗
  • Be flexible by a day or two — midweek flights are often cheaper than Friday/Sunday.
  • Compare the total, not the headline fare: bags and seat fees add up.
  • Check nearby airports — VPS vs. Pensacola, or BNA vs. a drive, can change the deal.
  • Book when it looks right — fares can rise while you wait, and the live site price is the real one.

🛏 Hotel price check

Same idea for rooms: pick a destination and dates, then compare live rates side by side.

Your hotel checks

Compare the nightly rate and the total with taxes and resort/parking fees before you book:

Booking.com ↗ Expedia ↗ Google Hotels ↗
  • Free cancellation options cost a little more but protect you if plans change.
  • Check the map — “near the beach” and “on the beach” are very different stays.
  • Condos and cabins with kitchens can beat hotels for families and groups.
  • Read recent reviews for cleanliness and noise, not just the star rating.

Pick your kind of stay

Not sure what to book? Start with the stay style that fits the trip — then search that style at your destination.

🏖 Beachfront hotel

Wake up on the sand with a pool, beach chairs, and no driving to the water. Best in Destin and Gulf Shores.

🏠 Condo or vacation home

Full kitchen, laundry, and room to spread out. Usually the best value for families and groups staying 4+ nights.

🌲 Mountain cabin

Deck, hot tub, and Smoky Mountain views. Best around Gatlinburg and Pigeon Forge — book early for fall colors.

🌆 Downtown hotel

Walk to music, food, and sights. The move for Nashville and New Orleans weekends where you won't need a car much.

Subscription terms — $15/month

  • Price — $15 per month: the subscription costs $15 per month, plus any taxes or fees the provider shows on its checkout before you confirm.
  • Monthly billing: $15 is billed once a month through the owner's connected payment provider only, starting on the date you subscribe on that provider's page. When the owner connects his payment provider, subscription payments will be paid out to his Chime bank account. No card or bank details are entered on this page.
  • Auto-renewal: it renews automatically each month at $15/month and keeps billing until you cancel — there is no fixed end date and no long-term contract.
  • Status: this subscription is active and open to new subscribers at $15/month.
  • What it covers: the monthly deals round-up by email only. It does not include hotels, flights, or bookings — trips are always booked and paid for separately on the travel site you choose.
  • Deal availability: featured fares and room rates are live third-party prices that can change or sell out at any time; the subscription does not hold or guarantee them.
  • Price changes: the current price is $15/month. If that price ever changes, it should be announced by email before the new price is billed, so you can cancel first if you don't agree.

Cancellation — easy, any time

  • Cancel any time: there is no minimum term and no cancellation fee charged by this site.
  • How to cancel: use the manage/cancel option in your payment provider's receipt or account page, or contact the owner by email and ask them to cancel — keep the provider's cancellation confirmation for your records.
  • When it takes effect: cancelling stops the next monthly renewal. You keep receiving deals until the end of the month you've already paid for, and you are not billed again after that.
  • Refunds: the month already paid is not automatically refunded when you cancel part-way through it, because deals for that month have already been provided — any refund in an unusual case is handled through the payment provider at the owner's decision.
  • Restarting: you can subscribe again later by completing payment on the provider's page again.

Points terms — Getaway Points

  • Who earns points: only active, paid $15/month subscribers. Points are earned under the email address used for the subscription, and are tracked by the owner from the payment provider's records.
  • Welcome points: 100 points, credited once per subscriber when the first $15 payment completes and the subscription becomes active.
  • Monthly points: 50 points for each paid month, including the first month, credited after that month's payment clears. A month that is not paid — because of cancellation, a failed payment, or a lapse — earns no monthly points.
  • Milestone bonuses: +100 points at 6 consecutive paid months and +250 points at 12 consecutive paid months. Cancelling or missing a month restarts the consecutive-month count from zero.
  • No cash value: points are a loyalty reward only. They are not money, cannot be exchanged for cash, cannot be transferred to another person, and cannot be used to pay for the subscription, hotels, or flights.
  • Cancelling: if you cancel, you stop earning new points. Points already earned stay usable for 90 days after your last paid month ends; after that they expire. Points already put into a drawing that is still open stay entered.
  • Errors and misuse: if points were credited by mistake, or an account is refunded or charged back, the owner may correct the balance or remove the related points and entries.
  • Point rewards: any rewards offered for points are provided by the owner of Getaway Booking and are subject to these terms and to the details in the announcement that offers them. The owner may change the earning rates or rewards for future months by announcing the change by email before it takes effect; points already earned are not taken away by a rate change.

Giveaway terms — Getaway Giveaway

  • Entries come from points: 50 points = 1 entry. Points you put into a drawing are deducted from your balance when you enter. There is no separate entry fee, and no payment or card details are entered on this page to enter — entries use points you have already earned as a subscriber.
  • Each drawing is announced first: the owner announces each drawing — the prize, the entry deadline, and the drawing date — by email to subscribers and/or on this page before the deadline. If a detail is not in the announcement, it is not part of that drawing.
  • Eligibility: you must have earned the points as a subscriber, and your subscription must have been active at some point during the entry period stated in the announcement. One subscriber account per person; entries from duplicate accounts may be removed.
  • How a winner is picked: one winner is drawn at random from all entries received by the deadline. The winner is notified at the email address on file for the subscription and must reply within 7 days; if they don't reply in time, the owner may draw another entry.
  • The prize: the prize for each drawing is the one described in that drawing's announcement — no other prize, cash alternative, or substitution is offered unless the announcement says so. Any taxes or fees that apply to a prize are the winner's responsibility unless the announcement says otherwise.
  • Who provides the prize: giveaway prizes are provided by the owner of Getaway Booking, subject to these terms and the drawing announcement. Linked travel sites and hotels/airlines do not sponsor or provide the giveaway or its prizes.
  • No guarantee of winning: entries improve your chances compared with not entering, but no entry or points balance guarantees a win, and the number of entries held by other subscribers affects the odds.
  • Changes: the owner may postpone or cancel a drawing by announcing it the same way the drawing was announced; points put into a cancelled drawing are returned to subscribers' balances.

Questions, answered straight

Do I book and pay on this page?

No. This page plans your trip and builds your searches. You finish booking and pay on a real travel site — Booking.com, Google Flights/Google Hotels, Expedia, Skyscanner, or the airline or hotel directly — where you get your confirmation number and cancellation terms. Never enter card or bank details on this page.

Why don't you show exact prices here?

Hotel rates and flight fares change constantly with dates, demand, and availability. Any price frozen on a page like this could be wrong by the time you click. The check links here take you straight to live prices for your exact dates, so what you see is what you'd actually pay.

What's the cheapest way to do a beach getaway?

Travel midweek, pick a condo with a kitchen instead of eating out every meal, compare Destin and Gulf Shores for the same dates, and check both flying (VPS/PNS) and driving totals — gas and parking versus fares and bags.

When should I book?

For cabins in the Smokies during fall and beach condos in summer, earlier is better because the good ones go first. For flights, compare as soon as your dates are set — fares for popular weekends tend to climb, not drop, as the date gets close.

Can I plan a trip somewhere not listed?

Yes — type any destination into the search boxes or the trip planner. The six featured getaways are just starting points; the fare and hotel check links work for any city.

How much is the monthly deals subscription, and how do I pay?

The subscription is $15 per month, billed monthly, with auto-renewal until you cancel. You pay only through the owner's connected payment provider, on that provider's own secure checkout page. When the owner connects his payment provider, subscription payments will be paid out to his Chime bank account. No card or bank details are entered on this page, and the interest form above does not charge you or start a subscription — the owner sends you the provider's payment link first, and you subscribe only if you complete payment there.

How do I cancel the $15/month subscription?

Any time, with no cancellation fee from this site. Cancel through the manage/cancel option in your payment provider's receipt or account page, or email the owner and ask them to cancel. Cancelling stops the next $15 monthly renewal; you keep the deals until the end of the month you've already paid for, and that paid month is not automatically refunded.

How do Getaway Points work?

Active $15/month subscribers earn 100 welcome points when their first payment completes, plus 50 points for every paid month they stay subscribed, with a +100 bonus at 6 consecutive months and +250 at 12 consecutive months. Points have no cash value, can't be transferred, and expire 90 days after your last paid month ends if you cancel. Full rules are in the Points terms in the subscription section above.

How do I enter the Getaway Giveaway, and who provides the prize?

You enter with points you've already earned: 50 points = 1 entry, and entered points are deducted from your balance. Each drawing's prize, entry deadline, and drawing date are announced by the owner by email and/or on this page before the deadline, and one winner is drawn at random from the entries received. All giveaway prizes and point rewards are provided by the owner of Getaway Booking, subject to the terms shown on this page — the linked travel sites do not sponsor or provide them. No payment or card details are entered on this page to subscribe or to enter.
